cohort: A 36/6 week near-term fetus who developed SVT after maternal treatment for renal colic.
finding: Maternal morphine treatment was found to induce supraventricular tachycardia in a near-term human fetus, which resolved following emergency cesarean section.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section led to the resolution of fetal supraventricular tachycardia symptoms in the neonate.
